summary.text: Ted Lieu is the Democratic incumbent U.S. Representative for California's 36th District and Vice Chair of the Democratic Caucus. Born in Taiwan and raised in Ohio, he is an attorney and retired Air Force Reserve colonel who served on the Torrance City Council and in the California Assembly and Senate before his 2014 election to Congress. He sits on the Judiciary and Foreign Affairs committees and describes artificial intelligence, civil liberties, cybersecurity and the environment as areas of focus.

paragraphs.text: Ted Lieu was born in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1969, and his official biography says his family immigrated to the United States when he was three and settled in Cleveland, Ohio, where his parents ran gift stores.

He earned a bachelor's degree in computer science and political science from Stanford University in 1991 and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center in 1994, graduating magna cum laude after serving as editor-in-chief of the law review.

Lieu served in the U.S. Air Force Judge Advocate General's Corps, four years on active duty and then in the Air Force Reserve, retiring in 2021 with the rank of Colonel, and he also clerked on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.
Lieu began his elected service on the Torrance City Council in 2002, after serving as a Torrance Environmental Quality Commissioner.

He then served in the California State Assembly from 2005 to 2010 and the State Senate from 2011 to 2014; his official biography cites state laws on subprime mortgages, a ban on conversion therapy for minors and a ban on tanning beds for minors, and says he co-authored the Global Warming Solutions Act.

Lieu was elected to Congress in 2014, was chosen Freshman Class President by his colleagues in his first term, and later served as Co-Chair of the Democratic Policy and Communications Committee before becoming Vice Chair of the Democratic Caucus.

He serves on the House Judiciary and Foreign Affairs committees, co-chaired the bipartisan House Task Force on Artificial Intelligence in the 118th Congress, co-chairs the Democratic Commission on AI, and served as an Impeachment Manager in the second Senate impeachment trial of Donald Trump.
According to his official biography, he lives in Torrance with his wife, Betty, a Torrance city councilmember, and their two sons.
